notes: Day 21: p85 continues the p84 last lines. Ge'ez opener ¶፩ (Mary feast) continues unnumbered from "በዛቲ ዕለት"; Amharic "አንድ" completes "ጥቅምት ሃያ" on p84 (join with space). Mary's arke follows; no Amharic arke on the page. Numerals ፪-፯ read from the scan (dotted, small) and are consistent with the running sequence; ¶፪ starts the Joel commemoration (ወበዛቲ ዕለት). Amharic ¶፫ continues across a line break with no numeral (sentence "በሐዋርያትና…" belongs to ¶፫). Flagged readings to check against the PDF: arke 1 "ሰማዩ" and "ደርከኖ"; ¶፫ "እክዮ", "እምን መንፈስየ", "ዕድ"; ¶፬ "ወይውርግዝ" (garbled), "በሐውርተ"; ¶፭ "የዐርብ"; ¶፮ "አሥመሮ"; ¶፯ "ይምሐረን" (doxology variant again, cf. p74/75/83/84). Joel arke: line-1 right end "ከመ" and "ኀልቀ", "ማኅጼ" read from the scan; the final arke line "ህየንተ በልዐ ቅድመ አንበጣ ወዕጼ" is short and reads continuous. Amharic: "ከኮረብታውም" kept as scanned; "ለዘለዓለሙ" (Mary) is partly hidden by the binding shadow (scan "ለዘለ|ለሙ"), inferred; "ፀሐይና" and "ምንጩ" slightly unclear.
